title: Founders 100K
description: The first 100,000 AirPal members form the founding pool. Sign up free, claim your founder number, and every prize is drawn from the pool. Bring your mates with your link — every mate who joins counts as a referral on your name.

prize.title: July Carry-On Light Expandable
prize.description: July's Carry On Light Expandable cabin case — the ultralight expandable rated 4.9 from 500+ reviews and backed by July's lifetime warranty. Colour of the winner's choice, subject to availability. See https://july.com/au/luggage/carry-on-light-expandable/
included: Ten × $100 AirPal credit for ten founders
Founder status for every pool member

eligibility: Australian residents aged 18 or over who hold an AirPal account. One entry per person. DRAFT — subject to legal review before publishing.
entryRules: 1. Sign up for AirPal (free). 2. Your entry is automatic once your account exists while the pool is open — first 100,000 entries only. 3. Share your personal invite link: every mate who signs up with it is recorded as your referral and earns you bonus points. 4. Winners are drawn at random from eligible entries and announced in-app. Entry never guarantees winning.
winnerSelectionMethod: Random draw from eligible entries, supervised and recorded. One prize per winner.
termsText: DRAFT TERMS — MUST PASS LEGAL REVIEW BEFORE PUBLISHING. 1. Promoter: AirPal.me. 2. Entry is free and open to Australian residents 18+ with an AirPal account. 3. The founding pool is capped at the first 100,000 eligible entries; entries after the cap are rejected. 4. One entry per person; duplicate or fraudulent accounts are disqualified. 5. Referrals must be genuine new members; self-referral is excluded. 6. Winners are selected by random draw from eligible entries and notified in-app and by email within 7 days. 7. Prizes are not transferable or redeemable for cash unless stated. The July suitcase prize is purchased at retail; this promotion is not sponsored by July. 8. Trade-promotion permit requirements to be confirmed by legal. 9. Full terms will be versioned and frozen at publish time.
privacyNote: Your handle may appear in masked form if you win (e.g. entry ENT-AIRP-••42). Full details in the official promotion terms.
